title: Warm Italian Veal Ossobuco
description: A classic Italian dish featuring braised veal shanks in a rich and flavorful broth, perfect for a lazy Sunday dinner. This keto-friendly recipe uses a tandoor for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the veal shanks with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in the tandoor and sear the veal shanks until browned on all sides.
Remove the veal shanks from the tandoor and set them aside.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery to the tandoor and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Add the garlic to the tandoor and cook for an additional minute.
Add the white wine, beef broth, and tomato paste to the tandoor, stirring to combine.
Return the veal shanks to the tandoor and bring the broth to a simmer.
Cover the tandoor and braise the veal shanks for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone.
Serve the veal shanks with the rich and flavorful broth, topped with grated parmesan cheese.
